worldFact.fact: Iten, a town of about 4,000 people perched 7,875 feet up on the edge of Kenya's Rift Valley, is nicknamed the Home of Champions. One local school has produced 25 world champions and five Olympic champions, and in 2011, 81 of the world's 100 fastest marathon men were Kenyan, most from within 50 miles of Iten.
